wordpress.name: WordPress
steps: Download the free Vouchly plugin using the button below.
In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
Choose the downloaded vouchly.php file and click Install Now, then Activate.
Go to Settings → Vouchly and enter your space slug: {{SLUG}}.
On any page or post, add the shortcode [vouchly] where you want the testimonials to appear.
Save and preview the page — your testimonial wall will load automatically.

shopify.name: Shopify
steps: In your Shopify admin, go to Online Store → Themes.
Click Actions → Edit code on your active theme.
Open the template file where you want testimonials to appear (e.g. sections/main-page.liquid or layout/theme.liquid for site-wide).
Paste the embed code just before the closing </body> tag (or inside the section where you want it to appear):
{{EMBED_CODE}}
Click Save. Your testimonials will appear on the next page load.

wix.name: Wix
steps: In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements (+) in the left sidebar.
Select Embed Code → Embed HTML and drag it onto your page.
Click the HTML block, then click Enter Code.
Paste the embed code below into the editor:
{{EMBED_CODE}}
Click Apply, then Publish your site. The testimonial wall will appear where you placed the block.

squarespace.name: Squarespace
steps: Open the page you want to add testimonials to in the Squarespace editor.
Click the (+) button to add a new block, then choose Code.
In the code block editor, make sure HTML is selected (not Markdown).
Paste the embed code below:
{{EMBED_CODE}}
Click Apply then Save. Testimonials will appear where you placed the block. Note: Code blocks require a Business plan or higher.

webflow.name: Webflow
steps: In the Webflow Designer, drag an Embed element from the Add panel onto your canvas.
Double-click the Embed element to open the code editor.
Paste the embed code below:
{{EMBED_CODE}}
Click Save & Close, then Publish your site.

framer.name: Framer
steps: In Framer, add a new Embed component from the insert menu (or press E).
Click the Embed component and select HTML from the embed type dropdown.
Paste the embed code below into the HTML field:
{{EMBED_CODE}}
Resize and position the component as needed, then click Publish.

html.name: HTML / Other
steps: Open the HTML file of the page where you want testimonials to appear.
Paste the embed code below just before the closing </body> tag:
{{EMBED_CODE}}
Save the file and upload it to your server (or redeploy your site). The testimonial wall will load automatically.
